test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: elect the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The passage describes the **adornments** that** Queen Gulnaar of Arabia wears.**
 
• **"Bangles"** fits the blank as it refers to circular ornaments worn around the arm, which aligns with the description in the passage.
 
• Other options like** "toe-rings", "anklets", and "ear-rings"** do not fit the context of being worn **on the arm and fingers**.
 
• The appropriate word for fill in the blanks no. 1 is** "****bangles."**

Therefore the correct statement from the passage is **"*A series of bangles__ of shell or ivory or thin metal clothed her left upper arm all the way down to her fingers."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** __Additional Information__ ** 

 
• "**Toe-rings"** are typically worn on toes and would not fit the context of being worn on the arm.
 
• **"Anklets"** are worn around the ankle and again, do not fit the context of being worn on the arm.
 
• **"Ear-rings"** are jewelry worn on the ears and do not fit within the context described for the arm and fingers.
